description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallada Kothmake D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330300
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property characteristics. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
